My top pick is the BONAI 16-Bay NiMH Charger if you regularly charge a lot of AA and AAA rechargeable batteries at once. Based on the search results you provided, it offers the highest capacity among the clearly described options, with individual charging indicators and support for mixed AA/AAA batteries.

Charges up to 16 AA or AAA NiMH/NiCd batteries in flexible combinations.

3. Tenergy TN480U 8-Bay NiMH Charger

$23.99

Charges eight AA or AAA batteries simultaneously, including mixed sizes.

Per-slot LCD status display and bad-cell detection.

Charges AA at 500 mA per cell and AAA at 250 mA per cell.

USB-C or Micro-USB input; a power adapter is not included.

Best for: A budget-friendly setup, or two units if you need 16 charging bays.
